licoes.texto: Create every task-mapped file before running the feature audit.
licoes.chave: ARQUIVO_INEXISTENTE::create every task mapped file before running the feature audit

licoes.texto: Run verify after replacing acceptance-test scaffolds with executable proofs.
licoes.chave: AC_SEM_PROVA::run verify after replacing acceptance test scaffolds with executable proofs

licoes.texto: Keep the parser keywords Dado, Quando, Então, Suposições, and Perguntas em aberto unchanged even when project prose is English.
licoes.chave: AC_INCOMPLETO::keep the parser keywords dado quando entao suposicoes and perguntas em aberto unchanged even when project prose is english

licoes.texto: Mark a task concluded only after its expected files and commit exist and onp-spec verify records PASS; an agent exit code alone is not completion.
licoes.chave: TASK_CONCLUIDA_SEM_PROVA::mark a task concluded only after its expected files and commit exist and onp spec verify records pass an agent exit code alone is not completion

licoes.texto: When a shared verification gate changes, refresh every affected feature proof before the final CI audit.
licoes.chave: VERIFY_OBSOLETO::when a shared verification gate changes refresh every affected feature proof before the final ci audit

licoes.texto: When retiring a PoC, update every historical task mapping to the maintained production replacement in the same change.
licoes.chave: ARQUIVO_INEXISTENTE::when retiring a poc update every historical task mapping to the maintained production replacement in the same change

licoes.texto: Before promoting a preserved draft, rescan all feature specs and reassign globally unique trace IDs.
licoes.chave: ID_DUPLICADO::before promoting a preserved draft rescan all feature specs and reassign globally unique trace ids
